title: ReplayShots
description: A replay's shot list, the one schema both simulator drivers read: X-Plane's plugin (tools/xplane-driver, wingtip_replay/shots.py) takes a shots.json of this shape, and the MSFS agent (tools/msfs-agent, Replay.Core/Shots.cs) its cameras by the same kinds in its --shots list. Each shot is a camera from one time to another, s from the flight's first row; the members beside kind, from_s and to_s are the camera's own (a chase's distance_m, height_m and lag_s; a flyby's lead_s, side_m and height_m; the tower's lat, lon, alt_ft and frame_m).

flight.description: The .fdr to replay, in X-Plane's Output/wingtip.

source.description: auto: ask X-Plane to load the .fdr, else place the airplane; menu: the pilot loaded it through Load Flight, and the plugin follows its replay; drive: the plugin places the airplane itself.

clock.description: fixed: each drawn frame moves the replay on 1/fps s, whatever the Mac's frame rate; real: the replay keeps to the wall clock.

to_s.description: The flight's end where left out.
